# Generic Shoulder Triangle-Lamina Candidate

Issue #12211 defines a separately identified mechanical hypothesis for the exact
derived 557-muscle OpenSim source. The unchanged source remains physically
rejected: its bilateral clavicle/scapula principal inertias fail chapter 52.
This candidate does not recover absent author BUET meshes or measured tissue
inertias. It retains the source's 557 muscles, joints, frames, path and wrap
laws, forces, and all four scalar shoulder body masses. Only those bodies'
centers of mass, six inertia components, and visual mesh references change.

## Source and Frame Declaration

The source XML SHA-256 is
`453e09c4e42dcc3f4b74a3b2efeff063e96c3820b3eee1efe95eef249579010d`.
It declares meters and unit-scale shoulder meshes attached directly to each
body. The right geometry comes from exact retained CEINMS MoBL files:

`2846d6daaa33b694d9eb59a02ea4716c43ac5d64c420a44909333e37d1223ff8`
and `scapula.vtp` SHA-256
`a62232c10aaa3b7c66a794ca947124fd59fffa3dea51e0c8457da50e16742d6b`.
Their identity placement in BUET body frames is an explicit generic
registration hypothesis, not author-source byte identity. The declared left
geometry reflects local right vertices with
$S=\operatorname{diag}(1,1,-1)$ and reverses triangle winding. It does not
insert the improper reflection matrix as a native body-frame rotation.
The exact source has eight clavicle and 81 scapula path locations mirrored
on each side under this $S$; these locations support but do not prove the
derived geometric registration.

## Area-Supported Mass Law

The Tools `compute_triangle_lamina` provider assigns a fixed original body
mass $m$ across the **triangle multiset** in proportion to unsigned area.
For triangle $t$ with area $A_t$, its mass is
$m_t=m A_t/\sum_j A_j$. Its centroid $c_t$ and within-triangle covariance
$C_t=\sum_{i=1}^3(v_{ti}-c_t)(v_{ti}-c_t)^\mathsf{T}/12$ give

$$
c=\sum_t \frac{m_t}{m}c_t,\qquad
C=\sum_t \frac{m_t}{m}\left[C_t+(c_t-c)(c_t-c)^\mathsf{T}\right],\qquad
I_C=m\left[\operatorname{tr}(C)\mathbf{1}-C\right].
$$

Duplicate or overlapping faces retain multiplicity; there is no surface
union, mesh repair, shell thickness, density measurement, volume or tensor
projection. The right clavicle has three boundary and three nonmanifold edges;
the right scapula has 13 and 23. A uniform **solid** interpretation remains
rejected for these open meshes. Equal bilateral scalar masses imply the
derived checks $c_L=S c_R$ and $I_L=S I_R S^\mathsf{T}$ in the corresponding
body frames. The original source's whole-body mass is unchanged, while the
shoulder first moments and origin inertias generally change; this is a new
mechanical plant, not a correction to the old one.

## Admission and Current Evidence

The producer verifies exact source/right-mesh hashes, shoulder mesh sockets,
unit scales, named body masses and mirrored source path locations before
writing a new XML and four explicit geometry assets. A whole-tree semantic
diff rejects any undeclared XML edit. The fresh native audit checks all 40
body masses, body-frame COMs and tensors against XML, using the shared
coordinate-invariant principal-moment law. It rechecks provider/geometry
hashes and compares every native body transform plus QErr/UErr for three
declared samples: initialized pelvis tilt and $\pm0.01$ SC_x offsets.

The current OpenSim 4.6 receipt identifies derived model SHA-256
`5f2cdd22013c2700f95d625a4c42eb488ed6c5267721cd0d2acde38544754326`.
Its 40-body native physical audit passes and the sampled maximum source versus
candidate transform and constraint-residual differences are both zero. The
unchanged source still fails the four bilateral clavicle/scapula physical
checks. This proves only a necessary generic physical condition and sampled
kinematic invariance. Native acceleration/work over a declared chart,
physiological muscle/passive and tendon laws, source-region ownership,
contact/grip, an independent head, private marker calibration, full-horizon
muscle excitation replay, all 17 variants and six-engine parity remain open.
No Moco solve or captured-motion fit is claimed. Calculation release and
publication remain blocked.
